subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

_____ this time next week I will be _______ Mumbai.
solution:
The correct answer is:** By; in**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper use of the given prepositions.

 
 
• '**On**' is only used with specific days, dates or named days.
 
• '**At**' is used to refer to the exact timing.
 
• '**In**' is used when speaking about geographical locations such as cities, towns, and countries
 
• '**By**' shows a time limit for something to happen.
 
• '**From**' refers to the place where someone or something starts or originates.
 
 
 
• As per the use of the given prepositions, **"By and In" **are the most option to fill in the blanks.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

Complete sentence:* **By __**this time next week I will be **__in __**Mumbai. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• The preposition '**in**' is used to denote an enclosed space or a limited area.
 
• While the preposition '**at**' is used to denote a specific point in an area.
 
• **At **this time means now. It pinpoints a moment or an approximate time.
 
• **By **this time means at any time up to now.
